metadata.title: Technical requirements for general-purpose centrifugal pumps.

pages.raw_text:
IS Codes for Industrial Pumps – Engineer
Purchasing Checklist
Introduction
An engineer buying 100 industrial pumps uses Indian Standard (IS) codes as a mandatory
technical checklist. These codes define manufacturing, performance, safety, and testing
requirements that every pump must satisfy before delivery. 1. Specifying the Exact Pump Type in
the Tender
• IS 5120: Technical requirements for general-purpose centrifugal pumps.
• IS 1520: Horizontal centrifugal pumps for agricultural and water supply applications.
• IS 8034: Submersible pump sets for clear, cold water.
• IS 5600: Sewage pumps. 2. Ensuring Electrical and Motor Compatibility
• IS 12615: Energy-efficient motors (IE2/IE3 classes).
• IS 325: Performance standards for three-phase induction motors. 3. Mandatory Inspection and
Testing
Using IS 9137 or IS 10981, the engineer requires:
• Hydrostatic test certificates.
• Performance curve testing for flow rate and pressure head verification. 4. Piping and Installation
Standards
• IS 1538: Cast iron flange dimensions for pump connections.
• IS 2062: Structural steel requirements for pump support frames. Summary Checklist
The purchase order may include:
“All 100 units must strictly comply with IS 5120 for construction, IS 9137 for performance testing,
and be driven by motors conforming to IS 12615.” Application Note
The exact IS codes may vary depending on the fluid being pumped, such as clear water, chemicals,
sewage, or oil.
